import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    prev = -1
    max_outside = 0
    inside_words = 0
    inside = False
    for index, c in enumerate(s):
        segment = index - prev - 1
        if c == '_':
            if not inside:
                if segment > max_outside:
                    max_outside = segment
            else:
                if segment > 0:
                    inside_words += 1
        elif c == '(':
            inside = True
            if segment > max_outside:
                max_outside = segment
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            if segment > 0:
                inside_words += 1
        if c in '_()':
            prev = index
    tail = len(s) - prev - 1
    if tail > max_outside:
        max_outside = tail
    print(f"{max_outside} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
